"""TEST-HARNESS SUBSTITUTION ONLY: a stand-in for platform request #15. Never part of the pack or v2.

On backend a1 (deployed 745b88f + broker additions), GuestSession.serve_route never binds an execution runtime, so
every assets.* call a route handler makes raises "no active execution for this guest" (transport/host.py _scope).
Request #15 asks the host to bind a request-scoped runtime limited to the route's declared permissions.

This shim binds, for the duration of one serve_route call, a runtime built the way core builds one for a node
(ExecutionPlan -> providers.ctx_provider.build, providers.ref_resolver_factory, providers.ops_provider). The route's
declared permissions are still enforced by the host (_require) exactly as without the shim. Rows that rely on it are
labelled "parity under a harness stand-in for platform request #15 (not live behaviour)".
"""

LABEL = 'parity under a harness stand-in for platform request #15 (not live behaviour)'


def install(guest_session_class, sdk_module):
    """Wrap serve_route on the real GuestSession class; returns a switch {'on': bool}."""
    plan = sdk_module.ExecutionPlan(prompt_id='ned-lora-info-route', node_id='route', node_type='route')
    runtime = sdk_module.Runtime(refs=sdk_module.providers.ref_resolver_factory(),
                                 ctx=sdk_module.providers.ctx_provider.build(plan),
                                 ops=sdk_module.providers.ops_provider)
    real_serve = guest_session_class.serve_route
    switch = {'on': True}

    async def serve_route_with_runtime(self, **kwargs):
        if not switch['on']:
            return await real_serve(self, **kwargs)
        previous, self._runtime = self._runtime, runtime
        try:
            return await real_serve(self, **kwargs)
        finally:
            self._runtime = previous

    guest_session_class.serve_route = serve_route_with_runtime
    return switch
